question: What is the revenue (quantity times price) of shipped orders from customers in each city? Return the city and the revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
reference: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.city

question: Which customer has spent the most on shipped orders, counting quantity times price? Return their name and the amount, rounded to 2 decimals.
reference: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * p.price), 2) AS spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the products that have never been ordered.
reference: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question: For each category, which is its most expensive product? Return the category and the product's name.
reference: SELECT category, name FROM products p WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products q WHERE q.category = p.category)

question: An order's value is the sum of quantity times price over its items. List the ids of the orders whose value is above the average order value.
reference: WITH v AS (SELECT i.order_id, SUM(i.quantity * p.price) AS value FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT order_id FROM v WHERE value > (SELECT AVG(value) FROM v)

question: For each course with at least 5 graded enrollments, what is its average grade, ignoring enrollments still in progress? Return the course title and the average rounded to 1 decimal.
reference: SELECT c.title, ROUND(AVG(e.grade), 1) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(e.grade) >= 5

question: List the names of the students whose average grade is higher than the average of all recorded grades.
reference: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id HAVING AVG(e.grade) > (SELECT AVG(grade) FROM enrollments)

question: Which teacher's courses have the most enrollments in total? Return the teacher's name and the number of enrollments.
reference: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN teachers t ON t.id = c.teacher_id GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the students who have taken both a Math course and a History course, each name once.
reference: SELECT s.name FROM students s WHERE s.id IN (SELECT e.student_id FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.department = 'Math') AND s.id IN (SELECT e.student_id FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.department = 'History')
